source_evidence: Player exact 'Bonus Hide, then action surge to attack BC. Then hold my action to attack when Cirren gets into melee with the BC. Tell Cirren, spirit guardians and get into melee with BC.' V moves20ft into established southern roadside brush (20,-15), takes Cunning Action Hide, d20 12+11=23 beats captain passive10 and scouts keen-senses passive20. Clear line to C within60ft, thrown Psychic Blade advantage6,19 +9=28 vs AC15, hit psychic d6 2+4=6 plus Sneak2d6 3,1=4, C65→55. Action Surge1→0; main action Ready Psychic Blade per adopted D308 exception, trigger Cirren/captain within5ft, reaction available, not spent. Attack reveals V. Cirren willingly casts 3rd-level Spirit Guardians, slots3→2, concentration, allies excluded, advances30ft via northern shoulder to(35,10), cannot reach C this turn, no trigger. Aura radius15 measured actual position; no enemy start/entry then. C independently moves around aura south to(35,-10), throws two daggers at V within20ft, 14+5=19 hit d4 1+3=4, V48→44; 3+5=8 miss. Vt Dash to(25,-15) adjacent V via south, no attack. Fenar moves to(30,-10), Rage4→3, Beast claws, Reckless, mechanical greataxe paired Double-Claw Rend advantage15,2 +8=23 damage9+7=16, claw14,19 +8=27 damage3+7=10, extra claw8,19 +8=27 damage6+7=13; total39, C55→16. Captain cannot use Parry profitably and retains reaction. S1 two arrows to Cirren: 15+4=19 hit1+2=3, Cirren51→48, concentration5+3=8 vs10 FAIL, Spirit Guardians ends, second6+4=10 miss. S2 arrows at Reckless Fenar adv10,1 +4=14 hit5+2=7 halved3, then adv20,8 critical 4+3+2=9 halved4, Fenar59→52. S3 arrows Cirren5+4=9 miss,19+4=23 hit4+2=6, Cirren48→42. T1 advances to(40,10), no aura active, maces8+4=12 twice miss vs18. T2 advances to(30,-15), adv17,8 +4=21 hit2+2=4 halved2, Fenar52→50; adv1,2 +4=6 miss. No ready trigger, no V reaction attack. All genuine visible receipts attached. No opportunity attack chosen or necessary; all actions and exact resources accounted. D321~10:31 Ossent frontier road, end R1/start R2 V initiative22, pending V turn. V(20,-15) at southern brush, not hidden after attack, HP44/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge0/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned. V's R1 readied Psychic Blade for Cirren and captain within5ft did not trigger, expires at start R2; R2 action/BA/reaction/movement30 fresh, no reaction attack, no further V choice. Cirren(35,10) HP42/51 AC18 HD6/6 slots4/3/2 CD2/2 boots; Spirit Guardians cast R1, concentration failed first arrow DC10 with5+3=8, ended before T1 entered; no active spell. Fenar(30,-10) HP50/59 AC14 HD6/6 Rage3/4 ACTIVE claws (magical Bestial Soul), Reckless advantage against her until start of her next turn, Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40; no THP. Captain C(35,-10) HP16/65 AC15, Parry ready, two daggers thrown R1, scimitar still wielded; Veteran(25,-15) HP58/58 AC17 adjacent V, longsword/shortsword drawn; T1(40,10) HP32/32 AC11 adjacent Cirren; T2(30,-15) HP32/32 AC11 adjacent Fenar; S1(40,25) S2(40,-25) S3(70,25) all HP16/16 AC13, partial cover from obstructed angles. All enemies alive, no additional foes, captain wounded badly, self-preserving withdrawal if leader disabled or majority down, no forced surrender. R2 initiative V22,Cirren21,C21,Vt20,Fenar18,Scouts6,Thugs3. Mara(-45,-5), merchant near(-35,0), coach(0,0), horse team x10–20, wool wagon(-40,0), horses x-30–-20; all uninjured. Road width20ft y±10, west positive x; brush south flank, broken walls around scouts, east retreat open. Purse3178gp4sp6cp, provisions9/feed12 before D321 daily charge, LR0/6, random encounter count2/5 consecutive2, no D321 night roll, D322 mandatory quiet. Letter/credentials, Kestrel evidence, existing commitments unchanged. V dice delegated, no other V decisions authorized. Await R2 action.
